analysis.summary: Alivus Life Sciences reported a strong operational and financial performance for Q2 FY27, with revenue growing 16% year-on-year to INR682 crores and significant expansion in profitability driven by new product launches and a favorable product mix. The non-GPL business grew 20.8% year-on-year and now contributes 79% of total revenues, while the CDMO business saw a robust surge with revenues climbing to INR50 crores. Management reiterated its FY27 revenue growth guidance of 10% to 12% and projected EBITDA margins in the 35% to 36% range. The company remains net debt-free with strong free cash flow generation and cash and cash equivalents of INR1,012 crores as of September 30, 2026. Alivus Life Sciences reported a strong financial performance in Q2 FY27 with a 16.0% YoY revenue growth and a PAT of ₹1,968 million.

guidance.claim: Management reiterated its FY27 revenue growth guidance of 10% to 12%.
guidance.quote: So accordingly, we reiterate our FY27 revenue growth guidance of 10% to 12%.

guidance.claim: The company is confident of delivering EBITDA margins in the 35% to 36% range in FY27.
guidance.quote: We are confident of delivering EBITDA margins in the 35% to 36% range in FY27.

guidance.claim: Management is guiding for revenue growth of 10% to 12% in FY27.
guidance.quote: We are guiding for revenue growth of 10% to 12% in FY '27 with growth skewed towards H2 FY '27.

guidance.claim: Management remains confident of sustaining EBITDA margins in the 30% to 32% range.
guidance.quote: We also remain confident of sustaining EBITDA margins in the 30% to 32% range.

guidance.claim: Growth in the GPL business is expected to remain flattish in FY27.
guidance.quote: While growth in the GPL business is expected to remain flattish in FY '27, the business has been historically weighted towards the second half of the year and we expect a similar trend to play out this year, resulting in a stronger H2 performance.

demand_outlook.claim: Revenue from operations for Q2 stood at INR682 crores, up 16% year-on-year, driven by new product launches and healthy demand across the existing portfolio.
demand_outlook.quote: During quarter 2, revenue from operations stood at INR682 crores, up 16% year-on-year, driven by new product launches and a healthy demand across our existing portfolio.

demand_outlook.claim: Performance remains healthy across Europe, Japan, North America, LATAM and ROW markets.
demand_outlook.quote: Performance remains healthy across Europe, Japan, North America, LATAM and ROW markets.

demand_outlook.claim: The generic API business grew 11% year-on-year in Q2 supported by healthy demand across regulated and emerging markets.
demand_outlook.quote: Our generic API business grew 11% year-on-year in Q2, supported by healthy demand across regulated and emerging markets.

demand_outlook.claim: Healthy demand trends and enhanced visibility provide confidence in sustaining the growth trajectory through the remainder of the year.
demand_outlook.quote: Looking ahead, healthy demand trends and enhanced visibility for H2 FY27 provide us with confidence in sustaining our growth trajectory through the remainder of the year.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that Q2 FY27 revenue growth was supported by healthy demand across all key markets and robust contributions from recent launches.
demand_outlook.quote: “Q2FY27 was another strong quarter for us, with revenue growing 16.0% YoY, supported by healthy demand across all key markets and robust contributions from recent launches.

demand_outlook.claim: The non-GPL business delivered strong growth of 26.5% year-on-year driven by successful new product launches and strong demand across all geographies.
demand_outlook.quote: Our non-GPL business delivered strong growth of 26.5% year-on-year, driven by successful new product launches and strong demand across all geographies.

demand_outlook.claim: GPL business experienced a decline of 52.6% year-on-year due to inventory rationalization.
demand_outlook.quote: GPL has been muted as a result of inventory rationalization. And so if you recall, Q4 was pretty strong, and we saw a dip in Q1, a decline of 52.6% year-on-year.

capex_expansion.claim: The Solapur facility continues to progress as planned and Phase 1 is expected to become operational in Q3 of FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Coming to our expansion plans, the Solapur facility continues to progress as planned and Phase 1 is expected to become operational in Q3 of FY27.

capex_expansion.claim: Construction of the R&D center at Taloja is progressing well and expected to be on schedule early next year.
capex_expansion.quote: Construction of our R&D center at Taloja is also progressing well, and we hope to be on schedule early next year.

capex_expansion.claim: Capex for the quarter was INR105 crores and for the first half, it was INR190 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: On the balance sheet and cash flow movement, capex for the quarter was INR105 crores and for the first half, it was INR190 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: Construction of a new R&D facility in Taloja is progressing steadily.
capex_expansion.quote: Construction of our new R&D facility in Taloja (Navi Mumbai) is progressing steadily.

capex_expansion.claim: A brownfield expansion in Ankleshwar is planned to add approximately 100 KL capacity by Q4 FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: Brownfield API / Intermediate Ankleshwar Planned addition of ~100KL Capacity Q4 FY27

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 1 of the greenfield Solapur facility involves approximately 340 KL for intermediate block and backward integration with a Q3 FY27 timeline.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 1 - ~340 KL (Intermediate block and Backward Integration) Q3 FY27

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 2 of the greenfield Solapur facility involves approximately 125 KL for API and pharma block with a Q4 FY27 timeline.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 2 - ~125 KL (API / Pharma block) Q4 FY27

capex_expansion.claim: Phase 3 of the greenfield Solapur facility includes a planned addition of approximately 535 KL by FY29.
capex_expansion.quote: Phase 3 - Planned addition of ~535 KL FY29

capex_expansion.claim: Solapur is expected to be operational in early Q3 of FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: There's a little bit of a delay, but it's going to be operational in early Q3 of FY '27.

capex_expansion.claim: Construction at the Taloja R&D center has begun and will happen on schedule.
capex_expansion.quote: Construction at Taloja, the R&D center has begun in earnest, and it will happen on schedule.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expects to incur a capex of approximately INR540 crores in FY27.
capex_expansion.quote: We expect to incur a capex of approximately INR540 crores in FY '27.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins for the quarter were at 41.8%, up 520 basis points quarter-on-quarter and 880 basis points year-on-year.
margins_costs.quote: EBITDA margins for the quarter were at 41.8%, up 520 basis points quarter-on-quarter and 880 basis points year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: Excluding onetime income, adjusted EBITDA margin was approximately 39.5%.
margins_costs.quote: Excluding the onetime income, adjusted EBITDA margin was approximately 39.5%, reflecting improved operating efficiencies.

margins_costs.claim: PAT for the quarter stood at INR197 crores with PAT margins at 28.9%.
margins_costs.quote: PAT for the quarter stood at INR197 crores with PAT margins at 28.9%, up 390 basis points quarter-on-quarter and 680 basis points year-on-year.

margins_costs.claim: Gross Margin for Q2 FY27 was 64.4%, up 420 bps QoQ and 670 bps YoY, driven by a favorable product mix.
margins_costs.quote: Gross Margin at 64.4%, was up 420 bps QoQ and 670 bps YoY, on the back of a favourable product mix.

margins_costs.claim: PAT Margin for Q2 FY27 was 28.9%, showing an increase of 390 bps QoQ and 680 bps YoY.
margins_costs.quote: PAT Margin at 28.9%, was up 390 bps QoQ & 680 bps YoY.

margins_costs.claim: EBITDA margins increased by 650 basis points year-on-year to 36.6%.
margins_costs.quote: Enhanced operational efficiencies and forex gains also supported 650 basis points Y-o-Y improvement in EBITDA margins to 36.6%.

orders_capacity.claim: The pipeline remains robust with over 630 DMF and CEP filings globally as on September 30, 2026.
orders_capacity.quote: Our pipeline remains robust with over 630 DMF and CEP filings globally as on September 30, 2026.

orders_capacity.quote: Our high-potent API portfolio continues to advance with 29 products in the active grid, representing a total addressable market of $82 billion.

capital_allocation.quote: We continue to remain a net debt-free company, and we have generated a strong free cash flow of INR270 crores leading to cash and cash equivalents, including short-term investments of INR1,012 crores as of September 30, 2026.

capital_allocation.claim: The company continues to remain a debt-free company.
capital_allocation.quote: We continue to remain a debt-free company.

risks_headwinds.quote: As we move into the second half of FY27, we remain mindful of the evolving external environment.

risks_headwinds.quote: So while we remain watchful of the evolving geopolitical and demand environment, the strength of our business fundamentals gives us confidence in our growth outlook.
